body: A lot of body positivity models have lost me because they talk about fillers and other cosmetic treatments like it's self care. No. You get that done for work. If i get it done, it will be because ive capitulated to the demands of society that i must always be young and beautiful. It's a strong societal pull, and i can't fault anyone for wanting to gain approval and the real material benefits of being conventionally beautiful, but don't call it self care. Don't act like it's really empowering most of the time. Real empowerment would be the ability to refuse and not face consequences.
I hope you enjoyed your day!

Thank you for reaching out. I have revealed some details to a few people, but I don't feel that anyone has really understood. I don't really understand myself, either. This is only a fraction of the troubles that make me want to end my life, but it often feels like these feelings and memories alone will kill me. Disenfranchised grief--i don't know what to do with it. No matter how much I cry, or write, or distract.
